comment: Pictures 1 and 2 are photos of the original pedal; picture 3 is the vero layout: a 19 x 8 fuzz board plus a 7 x 7 power board (ICL7660S inverter and 78L33 regulator making about -3V), each drawn populated and bare. Both populated boards are summed. Transistors carry no designators.
uncertain: 20u electrolytics (two, on the fuzz board): printed clearly, unusual value
